title: TensorUploaded
description: Successful checked upload observation, not a physical-memory verdict.

caps.description: Explicit execution tier and actual checked owned payload bytes.

decoded_source_bytes.description: Decoded scalar input bytes; never packed disk bytes or a savings claim.

physical_device.description: Backend-reported physical device identity, which may be unknown.

tensor.description: Caller-selected tensor name within the model or run.

TensorCaps.description: Declared execution and owned payload size for a specific semantic tensor.

execution.description: Direct execution or dense emulation; never inferred from ISA flags.

payload_bytes.description:
Bytes reported by the uploaded buffer, excluding allocator/handle
overhead, scratch, KV, other tensors, and total model residency.

TensorExecution.description: How a backend executes one semantic tensor combination (ADR 0044 D8/D9).

oneOf.description:
Executes additive coefficients directly, or an originally dense tensor.
This does not assert SIMD, accelerator speed, or empirical qualification.

Materializes an additive tensor as dense weights for plain GEMM.
Requires explicit evidence and memory admission before production use.
